desc: The Orlivane pocket guitar chord trainer is a small guitar neck with 6 strings and 6 frets for silent finger practice. It has a maple fingerboard, an ABS body with a slide-out cover and six tension screws you can adjust with the included hex key. It does not produce guitar sound and needs no battery. Comes with a velvet storage bag. Colors: black and white.
b: PRACTICE ANYWHERE — A pocket-size guitar neck with 6 strings and 6 frets for silent chord and finger practice on the train, at the desk or while traveling.
NOT AN INSTRUMENT — It does not make guitar sound and has no battery or screen; it is a finger practice tool for chord shapes, finger strength and chord changes.
ADJUSTABLE STRINGS — Six screws at the end of the neck let you adjust string tension with the included hex key.
MAPLE FINGERBOARD AND SLIDE-OUT COVER — Maple fingerboard with an ABS body; the slide-out cover protects the strings when closed. About 19.5 cm closed and 33.5 cm extended, 5 cm wide.
WHAT YOU GET — 1 pocket guitar trainer, 1 velvet storage bag and 1 hex key. Available in black or white.
